usage: The word 繼父 (gai3 fu6) refers to a man's role as a stepfather, the husband of one's mother but not one's biological father.
It is commonly used as a noun to talk about family relationships in blended families.
繼父 can act as the subject or object in a sentence when discussing family members.
This word typically appears in everyday conversation when describing or introducing family members.
It is not used to refer to a biological father or a stepmother.
